issue.title: CaptureTemplateStartTests.testTypingThirdAtStartsTemplateAndClosesBareAtAtCompletion times out on macOS
issue.description: Repo: bob-mac-capture. Proposing bead: bob-cli-a8 landing audit (not a child proposal). The test times out at line 122 waiting for completionVisible on the @@ draft and fails templateStartHintVisible at line 123 before typing the third @. This test was added by ad85b85 before the epic; the cause needs investigation in bare-@@ completion / fixture routing. Reproduces in macOS 26 CI runs 39499997621 (pre-epic 785508c), 39505351980 (e99cec6), and 39511067813 (1d5735a), with the same timeout and assertion. Root cause is unconfirmed, so size large allows planning. Fix the production or test defect without weakening the intended third-@ rewrite coverage. It is distinct from bob-cli-8e, which tracks older CaptureTemplatePresentationTests and header/newline failures, and from active bob-cli-8b's shelf changes: ad85b85 independently introduced this new gesture and test after that epic's code. Evidence artifact contains exact diagnostics and run URLs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical failure on three consecutive observed states: pre-epic 785508c (run 39499997621), e99cec6 (39505351980), and 1d5735a (39511067813). No passing rerun observed.

issue.creation_reason: Landing bob-cli-a8 revealed a repeatable pre-existing macOS CI failure that is not covered by the existing node-specific task scopes. Track it separately so the epic does not absorb unrelated baseline work.
